item.subject: science
item.stem: Ravi's teacher asks the class to classify some resources used at home in their village. A resource is renewable if it is replenished naturally within a reasonable period of time, and non-renewable if it takes millions of years to form and gets exhausted after use. Which of the following resources should Ravi classify as non-renewable?

options.A: Firewood collected from trees that are replanted every year
options.B: Kerosene oil, a fuel obtained from petroleum
options.C: Wind energy used to pump water from the well
options.D: Sunlight used to dry grain in the courtyard
